    /// Process intersect or except
    fn intersect_or_except(
        left_plan: LogicalPlan,
        right_plan: LogicalPlan,
        join_type: JoinType,
        is_all: bool,
    ) -> Result<LogicalPlan> {
        let left_len = left_plan.schema().fields().len();
        let right_len = right_plan.schema().fields().len();

        if left_len != right_len {
            return plan_err!(
                "INTERSECT/EXCEPT query must have the same number of columns. Left is {left_len} and right is {right_len}."
            );
        }

        // Requalify sides if needed to avoid duplicate qualified field names
        // (e.g., when both sides reference the same table)
        let left_builder = LogicalPlanBuilder::from(left_plan);
        let right_builder = LogicalPlanBuilder::from(right_plan);
        let (left_builder, right_builder, _requalified) =
            requalify_sides_if_needed(left_builder, right_builder)?;
        let left_plan = left_builder.build()?;
        let right_plan = right_builder.build()?;

        let join_keys = left_plan
            .schema()
            .fields()
            .iter()
            .zip(right_plan.schema().fields().iter())
            .map(|(left_field, right_field)| {
                (
                    (Column::from_name(left_field.name())),
                    (Column::from_name(right_field.name())),
                )
            })
            .unzip();
        if is_all {
            LogicalPlanBuilder::from(left_plan)
                .join_detailed(
                    right_plan,
                    join_type,
                    join_keys,
                    None,
                    NullEquality::NullEqualsNull,
                )?
                .build()

text: {"mechanism":"DataFusion's `intersect_or_except` builds `EXCEPT ALL` as a `LeftAnti` `HashJoinExec` with `NullEqualsNull`, so it drops every left row that has any matching right row instead of subtracting multiplicities.","trigger":["ast:set_op:except_all","data:setop:left_has_dups","data:table:dup_rows","data:type:integer","plan:HashJoinExec"],"prediction":[{"required":["ast:set_op:except_all","data:setop:left_has_dups","data:table:dup_rows","data:type:integer","plan:HashJoinExec"],"forbidden":["data:setop:left_has_null","data:setop:right_has_null","data:table:has_null"],"data_properties":[],"expect":"fail","why":"Even without NULLs, the left anti join drops all matching duplicate left rows instead of leaving the excess copies required by EXCEPT ALL."},{"required":["ast:set_op:intersect_all","data:setop:left_has_dups","data:table:dup_rows","data:type:integer","plan:HashJoinExec"],"forbidden":[],"data_properties":[],"expect":"fail","why":"The same LeftSemi join path returns every matching left duplicate rather than the per-value minimum multiplicity required by INTERSECT ALL."},{"required":["ast:set_op:except_all","data:type:integer","data:setop:left_has_null","data:setop:right_has_null","data:table:has_null"],"forbidden":["data:setop:left_has_dups","data:table:dup_rows"],"data_properties":[],"expect":"pass","why":"With no duplicate rows on the left, the left anti join returns exactly the left rows without a right match, matching EXCEPT ALL for these inputs."},{"required":["ast:set_op:except_all","data:setop:left_has_dups","data:table:dup_rows","data:type:integer","data:table:empty"],"forbidden":[],"data_properties":[],"expect":"pass","why":"When the right input is empty, the left anti join returns all left rows, preserving duplicates as EXCEPT ALL requires."}]}
